feedback: The candidate correctly implements 'each time the pot boils over, turn the stove down' and passes the checks. Format: valid paper-style RM with a nonempty FINAL_STATES header (u0), which is declared and is the right accepting state for a recurring reactive task (obligation discharged whenever no boil is outstanding). Semantics: the two-state cycle detects the rising edge of the persistent condition pot_boiling (a boil can only start from silence, so (u0, pot_boiling)->u1 fires exactly once per boil, and pot_boiling re-holding in u1 correctly falls to else), and the event stove_fixed returns to u0. Given the constraint that stove_fixed requires pot_boiling at the previous step and the RM is forced into u1 at every boil start, stove_fixed can never occur while in u0, so no fix is ever missed and no spurious reward is possible. All irrelevant propositions (siren, client, order, food events) are absorbed by per-state else self-loops in both states; no invented predicates, only listed ones used. Reachability: the first boil occurs at steps 30-90 and 5-8 boils happen per episode, so u1 is always reached and the fix is achievable within N_pot = 20 actions (worst case with full hands: drop, toggle, pick up). Compactness: two states is minimal for this detect-then-respond cycle. Regressions: none required, since pot_boiling persists until fixed and remaining in u1 under else correctly represents an outstanding obligation; the pot never resets by itself. Reward safety: rewards are nonnegative and bounded (at most ~8 boils x (0.1 + 1.0) ≈ 8.8 per episode); the +1.0 fix reward dominates, and the +0.1 onset reward marks an uncontrollable exogenous event that the agent can neither cause, prevent, nor farm (boil timing is scheduled), so it cannot distort the optimal policy - it merely makes the shaping slightly denser, which is adequate here since the fix is at most ~20 actions away and the environment itself applies the delay penalties. Minor note only: the +0.1 on boil onset is dispensable stylistically (reward for something the agent does not do), but it is harmless and bounded; no rewrite needed.
